name: Lenvatinib (RAI-refractory DTC)
cyclesNote: continuous daily dosing until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; not a fixed cycle count

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE draft protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

histology: radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid carcinoma (papillary / follicular / oncocytic)
supportiveCare: control hypertension before starting and monitor closely - hypertension is the most common lenvatinib effect; have an antihypertensive plan.
monitor for proteinuria, diarrhea, fatigue, hand-foot skin reaction, and arterial thromboembolic / hemorrhagic events.
reserve for progressive or symptomatic disease; indolent metastases may be observed.
continue TSH suppression alongside; use directed local therapy for dominant lesions.
monitoring: blood pressure (weekly early, then per visit)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 hypertension, significant proteinuria, or other grade 3 to 4 toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and resume at a reduced dose (typical reductions 20 mg, then 14 mg, then 10 mg daily) once recovered; obtain clinical review. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Lenvatinib
drugs.notes: Lenvatinib 24 mg PO once daily, taken continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity, is the standard starting dose for radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer (per standard guidelines, general reference; SELECT-trial dose). Reduce for hepatic / renal impairment or toxicity per labeling. Own wording - not a verbatim source copy.
